overall_notes: The paper focuses on training small language models to self-improve on math/reasoning tasks through interactive demonstrations with LLMs. The NLG aspect involves generating step-by-step solutions, self-feedback, and improved solutions. Evaluation is entirely automated using accuracy and self-improvement frequency/contribution metrics. No LLM-as-judge or human evaluation was conducted.
